questions.text: The car needs 34.0 kWh to reach 100%, but only 27.8 kWh can be added before 2016-05-18 05:30. Would you like to lower the target or set a later departure?

explanation: I can’t meet the 100% target by 2016-05-18 05:30: the charger can add only 27.8 kWh, while the car needs 34.0 kWh. What target or later departure would you prefer?
problems: EV needs 34.0 kWh, charger gives 27.8 kWh
